gold.title: The enableSqlExpressions function has flawed logic that always returns false, effectively disabling SQL expressions unco
gold.description: The enableSqlExpressions function has flawed logic that always returns false, effectively disabling SQL expressions unconditionally:

candidate.title: `enableSqlExpressions` can never return true — the feature-flag read is dead and inverted
candidate.description: The toggle lookup is computed and discarded; both branches return false. The feature flag has zero effect. The condition is also inverted relative to the name, making any fix that returns true when enabled incorrect.

missed_cleanup_gold_informational.title: Several methods such as NewInMemoryDB().RunCommands and db.QueryFramesInto return 'not implemented'.
missed_cleanup_gold_informational.description: Several methods such as NewInMemoryDB().RunCommands and db.QueryFramesInto return 'not implemented'.

promotion_candidates.title: Default (non-`expressionParser`) path isn't gated and reports valid SQL as malformed
promotion_candidates.description: Guard lives only in `ReadQuery`, reached only when `expressionParser` is enabled. Default path runs `UnmarshalSQLCommand` which fails with 'not implemented', swallowed into BadRequest claiming SQL is invalid, breaking existing dashboards with valid SQL.

promotion_candidates.title: Flag description, docs, and frontend still advertise working DuckDB SQL expressions
promotion_candidates.description: Feature-flag registry, docs, and frontend UI advertise DuckDB SQL expressions as working when the dependency is removed and the feature is non-functional, misleading operators into enabling a broken feature.
